text: - **Harness-driven tests:** the harness wraps any blitz_dom Document, such as HtmlDocument or DioxusDocument, with deterministic construction defaults, a pump/tick loop, `settle` (that pass repeated until no work is due, returning `Settled` or `NotSettled` naming the `Busy` class), inspection helpers and input synthesis (packages/blitz-test-harness/src/lib.rs:1-19), and since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot a paint with no display — `Harness::screenshot` / `screenshot_rect` into `VelloCpuImageRenderer`, composited over opaque white, at the harness's own time with no tick or pump (packages/blitz-test-harness/src/screenshot.rs:37-103), and since 2026-10-13-stand-contrast-harness a contrast reader — `Harness::text_contrast(node_id) -> Option<TextContrast>`, reading and changing nothing (no mutation, input, pump or settle; every node by `get_node`): the text-bearing element's computed `color`, font size and weight over the background composited source-over from its ancestors' `background-color`s onto the root-else-`body` canvas over opaque white, `None` with no text or where an element on the walk has `opacity` below 1, a filter or a background image, and `contrast_ratio` the WCAG 2.x ratio over the `color` crate's relative luminance (packages/blitz-test-harness/src/contrast.rs:13-23; packages/blitz-test-harness/src/contrast.rs:56-91); dom_string produces a stable one-node-per-line tree serialization with geometry, described as suitable for snapshot-style assertions (packages/blitz-test-harness/src/inspect.rs:117-131)

text:
- **Process-lifecycle checks:** a check that needs a session process starts and stops its own host — its own test binary re-run on one `#[ignore]` child (`--ignored --exact {child} --nocapture`), or the package's own binary through `CARGO_BIN_EXE_*` — with every wait bounded, a guard that kills and reaps a host a failing check still holds, its state directory under `CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR` removed at `stop`, and the child's streams sent to null unless the check reads them, so the child's own libtest lines never reach the parent's output, where `agent-run.sh` would count them as tests; such a check, holding a session over the socket, is `cfg(unix)`-gated — while since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface seven_guis' `mcp_server` and `mcp_log` spawn `escher-session mcp` as a child spoken to over piped stdin through the shared module's `Speaker`, which reads the child's stdout line by line on a thread under the 30 s `REPLY_BOUND` and kills and reaps the child in its `Drop`, and are not unix-gated but `mcp_server`'s command-line comparisons, two since 2026-10-12-self-description, so the windows CI job runs them (green on CI#38124028789 attempt 2, `Test (windows)`) (examples/seven_guis/tests/common/mod.rs:203-211; examples/seven_guis/tests/common/mod.rs:332-337; examples/seven_guis/tests/mcp_server.rs:382-423); blitz-tests' three `#[ignore]` host children — `session_host`, `session_host_with_typed_text` and, since 2026-10-10-driver-cli, `session_host_with_a_short_expiry` — serve until stopped or until idle for their expiry, `IDLE_EXPIRY` (1,800 s) for the first two and a short one for the third, so a bare `--ignored` run of blitz-tests waits on a host for its expiry; a check that waits for an expiry watches the state directory, because an `attach` — and so the `status` command — is an answered request and starts the count again;
 a host the binary's own `start` command spawns has its streams closed and is neither killed nor reaped by that command, so the seven_guis checks hold such a session behind a guard that stops it; and a check that captures a host which installs escher's sink drains its pipes while the host runs, or captures to a file — the seven_guis checks read each stream on a thread from the spawn on: since 2026-10-07-sink-target-allowlist such a host writes one 124-byte install line at `info`, `debug` and `trace` — plus, since 2026-10-10-driver-cli, one `command` span line per call it runs and, built by the workspace, the engine's `blitz_dom::document` line — one until 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep, two since (the `focussed node` line printed twice) —, and the `escher-session mcp` child, since 2026-10-10-mcp-surface, one `tool_call` span line per `tools/call` it answers, the parent of that call's `command` line, so a check capturing that child counts its lines by span and target — where before the drop it wrote about 1.1 MB of stderr at `trace` against a 64 KiB pipe, so a check that must fail red on a sink that leaks again cannot wait for exit before it reads (tests/blitz-tests/tests/session_common/mod.rs:323-408; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_session_lifecycle.rs:42-47; examples/seven_guis/tests/common/mod.rs:35-44; examples/seven_guis/tests/common/mod.rs:46-55; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-session/report.md, the drop and `host_log` at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-sink-target-allowlist/report.md, the third host child, the idle expiry and the hosts a `start` command spawns at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/report.md)

text: - **Command-line checks and shell flows (since 2026-10-10-driver-cli):** seven_guis' checks run the package's own `escher-session` binary once per command as a client process and read its stdout, its stderr and its exit status — `0` accepted · `1` refused · `2` usage · `3` session error — through the shared runner of `tests/common/mod.rs`, which bounds the run and drains both streams; and two POSIX `sh` scripts under `examples/seven_guis/tests/flows/` (`counter.sh`, `flight.sh`), a non-Rust test asset, are run under plain `sh` by the Rust target `cli_flow`, and since 2026-10-19-recorded-check-replay a third, `record_checks.sh` (the binary and an existing output directory its two arguments, `rec/` made `0700`, printing only `step N` on failure), by seven_guis `recording`'s unix-gated `the_committed_checks_are_what_the_binary_records` — the scripts are assets of a `cargo test` target, not a runner of their own, and no test framework is added; the three targets are `cfg(unix)`-gated (examples/seven_guis/tests/common/mod.rs:57-128; examples/seven_guis/tests/cli_flow.rs:31-74; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/report.md)

text: - **Recorded-check replay (since 2026-10-19-recorded-check-replay):** a check a session recorded, committed as data under `tests/blitz-tests/checks/` (`counter-cli.json`, `counter-mcp.json`, git mode `100644`), read by the strict `Check::from_bytes` and run as an ordinary `cargo test` target (`stand_replay`) through `Check::replay` — every step re-validated through `Session::run`, red at the first step whose acceptance or kept answer differs, the answers compared as JSON values — and kept fresh by a byte-for-byte comparison with what the binary records (seven_guis `recording`); picked up by `agent-run.sh run stand`, stand-repeat and the CI `test` leg on three OSes with no script change (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_replay.rs:24-36; examples/seven_guis/tests/recording.rs:187-203)

text: - **Claims mapped to checks:** `docs/capabilities.md`, a document with no runtime surface, ends on `## Where each claim is proven`, naming the check behind each claim it makes — the stand checks the `stand-repeat` leg runs among them — and states each limit as pinned by its check or as asserted by no check (the `select` model's limits); only its names and counts are held to the schema's tables, by the CI-script pin `test_capability_statement.py` (§4), so a check renamed or moved changes that section by hand (docs/capabilities.md:172-174; docs/capabilities.md:188-192; docs/capabilities.md:300-301)

text: - **Pixel tests:** render to a CPU buffer and sample pixels; box-shadow expectations come from Chromium renders with a 1px antialiasing tolerance (tests/blitz-tests/tests/paint_order.rs:12-29; tests/blitz-tests/tests/outset_box_shadow_shape.rs:6; tests/blitz-tests/tests/outset_box_shadow_shape.rs:82-88); since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot frames are also compared whole — a shot's PNG equal to the harness's raster (`stand_act_screenshot`), byte-identical across two child runs of the test binary's own `#[ignore]` child, whose stdout the check reads, and the parent on one host, 12 shots in both layout modes under both builds (`stand_screenshot_repeat`) — a shot's PNG bytes differ between linux x86_64 and macOS aarch64 (CI#39225375577), so a check compared byte for byte across OSes holds no shot — and a password field's pixels equal for two values of one length (`password_painted_masked`, through `render_to_buffer::<VelloCpuImageRenderer, _>`); a check decodes a PNG through blitz-tests' `png` dev-dependency, or, in seven_guis, which has none, by a hand base64 reader and the PNG header (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_screenshot_repeat.rs:75-137; tests/blitz-tests/tests/password_painted_masked.rs:41-82)

text: - **WPT conformance:** reftests render test and reference to RGBA buffers at 800x600 and compare them exactly, by fuzzy tolerance, or by dify diff (wpt/runner/src/test_runners/ref_test.rs:26-103; wpt/runner/src/test_runners/ref_test.rs:184-217); attr tests check element layout against `data-expected-*` attributes, one subtest per element matching the selector (wpt/runner/src/test_runners/attr_test.rs:71-133); harness tests run real testharness.js and collect per-subtest results (wpt/runner/src/test_runners/harness_test.rs:119-183); the first conformance reading taken on the fork's dev host, at 2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit: the suite `css/cssom-view` at the commit `wpt/WPT_COMMIT` pins (71b4d5f0eb7628a5d5f7cd2ee868ce1b1b5dc010), run before and after the two engine fixes — 966 → 967 subtests passed of 2292 run, one moved fail to pass (`css/cssom-view/getBoundingClientRect-scroll.html`, "getBoundingClientRect for a scrolled scroll container") and none pass to fail; report-only, it grades no criterion (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit/evidence/conformance.md, which holds its cost)
